transports.description: PostgreSQL MCP server (stdio via uvx, restricted mode). Requires DATABASE_URI. Restricted mode: SELECT and EXPLAIN only; DDL/DML blocked by pglast AST validation.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query against the configured PostgreSQL database. Restricted to SELECT and EXPLAIN statements in default mode.

tools.name: list_schemas
tools.description: List all schemas in the database.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in a schema.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get column definitions, types, and constraints for a table.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Retrieve table/index statistics for performance analysis.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE) on a query to surface execution plan and cost.

checks: install: uvx postgres-mcp==0.3.0 (version-pinned Python package via uv/pip)
access-mode: restricted (SELECT/EXPLAIN only via pglast AST validation)
trust.notes: Community PostgreSQL MCP server. Deployed in restricted mode — pglast AST validation allows only SELECT and EXPLAIN statements; DDL/DML blocked at the server layer. Note: COPY statement validation was commented out in the pglast validator as 'will be validated' but is not yet implemented; the DATABASE_URI role is the enforcement backstop.
trust.securityNotes: Deployed in restricted access mode (SELECT/EXPLAIN only). Use a read-only PostgreSQL role scoped to the target schema as the primary access control layer — the COPY bypass in pglast restricted mode means the role-level permission is load-bearing. DATABASE_URI is stored as a dmcp secret and never logged. Source pinned to SHA 07eb329c8c48e49640e0d1b5b35465d4d024c3ee to prevent silent supply chain updates. Prompt injection risk: untrusted data in query results can include SQL or natural language that influences subsequent LLM reasoning — treat all query results as untrusted.
